notes.title: Tower! Simulator 3 - 40% OFF NOW
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, it's been a while 🙂 As we look back on our journey, we can't help but feel a swell of pride for the golden days of FeelThere, from 2002 to 2010ish, when we were at the forefront of developing aircraft for Microsoft's Flight Simulator. Since then, we've shifted our focus to our own air traffic control simulation product line, with Tower! Simulator 3 leading the charge nowadays. Yet, despite its rising popularity, it seems that many are still unaware of this gem in our arsenal. 

Let's set the record straight. Our passion lies in creating immersive experiences for the flight simulation community, especially airports. While these airports are also compatible with Microsoft Flight Simulator, Tower! - Air Traffic Control simulator is our heart and soul. 

[h3]We are now offering 40% discount until the 20th of May on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2176130/Tower_Simulator_3/] Tower! Simulator 3[/url], as we are slowly phasing out and will discontinue the older version + DLC of Tower!3D & Pro. 
[/h3]

This change unfortunately must happen, as there are continuous developments with our voice recognition and so many new hardware out there, simply put, there is no way we can match this old versions compatibility to these new developments, and therefore can't guarantee a smooth and enjoyable experience with it. We believe that this discount will change your mind to switch over after our latest Update 3 that bring the voice recognition to a new level. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2176130/view/4202498029356074260?l=english]Read our latest post about the update here!
[/url]

notes.title: Have you heard? Prepare for take off with the NEW Tower! Simulator 3 coming soon
notes.content:
Since our last upgrade back in 2017, when we released Tower!3D and Tower!3D Pro, we’ve come a long way to announce that soon we are publishing the next Tower! Simulator 3 game 

Make sure to add it your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2176130/Tower_Simulator_3/]Wishlist now[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28049616/69d0c87cc5e84ae4a15c93025242f41de0bdaeb6.jpg[/img]

This is not just an update or fix. This new version will leave you shocked! Designed to allow aviation fans, enthusiasts, ATC students and anyone interested in air traffic control to play and practice controlling from their living room.

This new version could showcase some of the cutting-edge technology we’ve been working on, including ultra high-res imagery, completely rewritten weather system. We’ll be offering this version as a training tool for Universities, students and air traffic control centers. By continuously receiving feedback from professionals, such as our partner the Department of Aviation of Hampton University, will ensure a very high level of simulation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28049616/faa9ed96905600714032b04248fee52fc4001a89.jpg[/img]

We will regularly give you updates during the development introducing new images and features, so keep checking back on our news site on feelthere.com and make sure sign up to FeelThere’s newsletter too.
[url=https://feelthere.com/news/]Go to News site and subscribe now>>[/url]

Overall, we’re excited to see new users take up "simming" with the new Tower! Simulator 3 as well as take our current controllers on a journey of discovery, with great content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28049616/d397044fddfc8e82b0edb43cb6d09d30a1610e49.png[/img]

notes.title: New DLC for Tower!3D and Tower!3D Pro
notes.content:
Beijing Daxing International Airport (IATA: PKX, ICAO: ZBAD), 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28049616/4e26b16f78854280169a45bf559ef5ea7c6bee96.png[/img]

ZBAD is Beijing’s second international airport that has been nicknamed “the starfish” because of its look. 

[previewyoutube=oGXoNfCYVQE;full][/previewyoutube]

The airport is a hub for SkyTeam alliance airlines and some Oneworld members. 
After almost five years of construction, it is the world's largest single-building airport terminal.

The airport was planned to be able to handle 120 to 200 million passengers a year making it the world's busiest airport by passenger traffic, if capacity were fully used. Ground transportation center was constructed beneath the terminal building. 



Daxing airport is one of the most exclusive design from the FeelThere fleet for the Tower!3D and Tower!3D Pro ATC simulation game, brining you the fun and excitement that you’d experience in a real ATC environment.

notes.title: Washington Dulles Intl. Airport for Tower!3D Pro Released
notes.content:
[b]Announcing the latest airport for Tower!3D Pro released today. 
[/b]
[b]Washington Dulles International Airport [KIAD] for Tower!3D Pro[/b]

An international airport in the Eastern United States, located in Loudoun County and Fairfax County in Virginia, 26 miles (42 km) west of Downtown Washington, D.C.

Dulles is a major hub for domestic and international air travel with a mixture of legacy and low fare carriers that provide air service throughout the world. Flights operate from midfield concourses A, B, C and D and from Z-gates connected to the Main Terminal.

This airport has the most international passenger traffic of any airport in the Mid-Atlantic outside the New York metropolitan area, including approximately 90% of the international passenger traffic in the Baltimore–Washington region. The airport is considered the region's international air hub, with dozens of nonstop international flights.

The current four-runway configuration has a capacity of up to 600,000 aircraft operations per year. With a future fifth runway constructed, the airfield capacity could increase to 1 million aircraft operations per year.

notes.title: New Airport for Tower!3D Pro Released - [KEWR]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28049616/6e4546a2fb45468df8b90ed357f3b0f7ef1bdaf8.jpg[/img]

[b]We are announcing the latest airport for Tower!3D Pro released last Friday. 
[/b]
[b]Newark Liberty International Airport[/b]
IATA: EWR, ICAO: KEWR, FAA LID: EWR 

It is one of the major airports of the New York metropolitan area. 
Newark Airport is located 3 miles (4.8 km) south of Downtown Newark, and 9 miles (14 km) west-southwest of the borough of Manhattan. It is one of three major airports serving the New York metropolitan area; the others are John F. Kennedy International Airport and LaGuardia Airport.

If you’re traveling by plane frequently, you’ve probably had an opportunity to go through EWR at least once while in NYC. But, how much do you actually know about this airport?

As the first NY airport, EWR used to be one of the busiest airports not only in the U.S., but also in the world. Although it is now one of the three airports in the area, it’s still quite busy as it hosts both domestic and international flights.

In fact, in 2017, it was recorded as the sixth busiest airport for international flights and the fifteenth busiest in general in the country. This means that you should expect EWR to get a bit crowded, especially during peak travel times.

On average, around 1,200 flights per day are scheduled to and from Newark Airport. As already mentioned, the airport offers both domestic and international flights for 30 different airlines.

notes.title: SP2 FOR TOWER!3D PRO HAS BEEN RELEASED
notes.content:
Dear Controllers,

As we promised earlier the SP2 for Steam is available at the same time we distribute it on our websites.

Here are the list of fixes:
-the most important thing is we found a way to further optimize and you should see some considerably better performance (fps)
-the readback (and handling heading) for numbers under 100 had some problem so it's fixed now
-pink menu for DX9. It should be fixed
-GA traffic now will arrive
-local traffic will work and will perform its task without freezing mid air
-strips for the local traffic will be removed once the plane lands
-we added more variants for the wind
-fixed the wind direction at KLAX
-if you have a mid -air you will be penalized only once
-at certain condition pilots were able to crash each other during taxi. Should be OK now
-in multiplayer if you used the mouse to click on the Command Panel, the commands disappeared on the host computer once the client issued a command. Fixed

Thank you

The Dev Team

notes.title: A service pack for Tower!3D Pro has been released!
notes.content:
The SP1 for Tower!3D Pro is released and it's available now.
It is possible add-ons (DLCs) needs to be reinstalled after the update.

The list of fixes:
-Undocked ADIRS crashed at some users
-Selecting runways on undocked ADIRS weren't highlighted
-we changed the colors on ADIRS for some functions for better visibility
-double letter taxiways (such as KK on KJFK) should be preannounced correctly by the pilots now 
-on KLAX we fixed the houses on the runway 
-on KLAX we fixed some textures
-on KPHL we aligned the runway centerlines 
-we optimized some rendering by making the game run faster on some systems.

Since we locked the list of fixes of this SP we got some reports about new possible issues. Although they didn't make this SP it doesn't mean they will not be addressed in a next SP if necessary.

Thank you

The feelThere Team
